description: Wiz cloud security platform connector (CSPM findings, misconfigurations, toxic combinations). Read-only; surfaces severity, status, type, source rule, entity, projects, description into the local index. Wiz uses OAuth client_credentials auth; the connector fetches a fresh access token at startup. Regional users override `wiz.api_url` + `wiz.auth_url` vault keys; the default sandbox manifest covers the public US-east tenant. Self-hosted / regional endpoint expansion is a known Task 14 runtime-merge follow-up.
author: Nimbus
